formulas.description: 60.0 or 120.0 - The added minutes to the current datetime. 1440 - The total number of minutes of the 24 hours.
formulas.name: currentDateTimePlusMinutes
formulas.expression: CASE({!NextCallAttemptFormula}, "2nd Attempt", NOW() + (60.0 / 1440), "3rd Attempt", NOW() + (60.0 / 1440), "4th Attempt", NOW() + (120.0 / 1440), NOW() + (120.0 / 1440))

formulas.description: Returns true of the DOB inputted matches the DOB on the contact record
formulas.name: DOBMatch
formulas.expression: AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Records_Contact.Birthdate})), NOT(ISBLANK({!inputtedDOB})), LEN({!inputtedDOB}) = 8, VALUE(LEFT({!inputtedDOB}, 2)) >= 1, VALUE(LEFT({!inputtedDOB}, 2)) <= 31, VALUE(MID({!inputtedDOB}, 3, 2)) >= 1, VALUE(MID({!inputtedDOB}, 3, 2)) <= 12, DATE( VALUE(RIGHT({!inputtedDOB}, 4)), VALUE(MID({!inputtedDOB}, 3, 2)), VALUE(LEFT({!inputtedDOB}, 2)) ) = {!Get_Records_Contact.Birthdate} )

formulas.name: DOBMatch_Lead
formulas.expression: AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Record_Lead.Date_of_Birth__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!inputtedDOB})), LEN({!inputtedDOB}) = 8, DATE( VALUE(RIGHT({!inputtedDOB}, 4)), VALUE(MID({!inputtedDOB}, 3, 2)), VALUE(LEFT({!inputtedDOB}, 2)) ) = DATEVALUE({!Get_Record_Lead.Date_of_Birth__c}) )

formulas.description: Returns the next call attempt, else, returns blank.
formulas.name: NextCallAttemptFormula
